query: SELECT json_build_object('source_pages',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages s JOIN public.books b ON b.id=s.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND s.source_page BETWEEN 909 AND 913),'topics',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.topics t JOIN public.chapters c ON c.id=t.chapter_id JOIN public.books b ON b.id=c.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND c.slug='europe' AND t.slug IN ('civic-rights-duties-boundary-909','governance-questions-boundary-910','governance-questions-boundary-911','governance-questions-boundary-912','economics-ldc-reference-boundary-913')),'facts',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 909 AND 913),'notes',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 909 AND 913),'mcqs',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 909 AND 913),'mcq_options',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 909 AND 913),'verifications',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 909 AND 913),'flashcards',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0909-0913:%'),'search_documents',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d JOIN public.gk_facts f ON d.entity_type='fact' AND d.entity_id=f.id WHERE f.source_page BETWEEN 909 AND 913)) AS batch_integrity LIMIT 1;
